findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素未列出取代其服務的替代技術；列出的替代性威脅是客戶自有員工的內部服務團隊（in-house）與垂直整合帶來的競爭加劇。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: We also expect increased competition from in-house service providers because some of our customers have employees who perform service work similar to the services we provide. Vertical consolidation could also contribute to competition in our industry.

note: 兩次搜尋（模組化/預製、液冷）未找到有來源的技術取代 FIX 機電施工的證據；液冷與混合冷卻搜尋結果顯示承包商技能需求改變，未見取代論述。搜尋結果無可逐字複製的原文，故不列為 finding。
